approval.approved_statement: The maintainer authorized deployment of the latest DJConnect API main after being shown candidate 4e6671c3231187e7cd20243817a86a56ad6aad06 and the cloudflare_workers_production target. This manifest binds the qualified candidate to artifact 11162680795 with SHA-256 458c4291fef9e88b10cedd68790b7f8bbff0b54b4264c73c8dac222f0b2a4770, followed by the matching public health smoke.
approval.effect: This approval authorizes only the specified API candidate and Cloudflare Workers production target. It does not authorize a stable release, public product promotion, client-store submission, or deployment of another Platform 4.0 component.

constraints: The candidate is an internal prerelease and must not be represented as a stable or public product release.
The Cloudflare Worker deployment and public health smoke remain separately dispatched and must use the exact artifact binding above.
The release is valid only after the matching post-deployment smoke confirms the public health version and release SHA.
next_authorized_action: Dispatch the Cloudflare Workers production deployment, then its matching post-deployment smoke, for the exact binding above.
